forms: Water/prepared aqueous forms for IDs 1–9,11,14–16,25; finite CO2 gas and Calcite/Gypsum solid batch forms. Hydrated and raw solid forms of prepared stocks are not implemented.
combinations: IDs 2–6,11,14: tested dilute acid/base/salt mixtures and water. IDs 7–9,15,16,25: same reagent or water only. Batch samples: empty-vessel aliquots only.
runs: 81 stock/aliquot/dilution iterations (75 distinct stock conditions), dilute pH references, native integration, nine UI preparation/transfer/readout flows; 108 batch condition sets with repeat and aliquot checks; gypsum/Henry references and low-pressure gas law; 45 additional stock conditions, amounts, repeated aliquot transfers, sulfate neutralization; total 14 prepared aqueous UI flows

batch.limitations: Separate independent final-equilibrium trials. One selected solid: Calcite or Gypsum. Closed ideal CO2 headspace or fixed external CO2. Extracted liquid only aliquots into empty vessels; no remix/dilution. Fixed 25 C, no kinetics, vapor, air or pressure correction.
